column1: # libutils path <TAB> upstream QEMU path, as of the tag recorded in BASELINE.
# Only the vendored QEMU utilities appear here: the files below include/utils/
# The rest of libutils (QAPI, QObject, the visitors, coroutines,
# fsigc++) is S2E-original or diverged far enough that it is not merged
# utils/spinlock.h) have no upstream counterpart at all. The merge driver
# is scripts/upgrade/merge.sh at the S2E source root.
# These track BASELINE. Files not listed as changing upstream since v8.1.0
# were simply never touched there, so they are current by definition.
# Pruned copies: upstream text with whole sections removed because they need
# meson configuration, os-posix.h, the Error API or sockets. They merge
# mechanically as long as upstream leaves the kept sections alone; a conflict
# in a removed section is resolved by deleting it again. bswap.h keeps the
# host-only half; the MemOp and target-endian half is libtcg's utils/bswap.h.
# cutils.h drops the prototypes whose bodies cutils.c prunes.
# More pruned copies, from the qht/rcu/thread import. thread.h drops win32
# and the QSP profiler indirection (its macros call the _impl functions
# directly); futex.h drops win32; lockable.h drops CoMutex; notify.{h,c}
# drop NotifierWithReturn (Error API); qht.{h,c} drop qht_statistics
# (qdist is not vendored); rcu.c drops the BQL around callbacks and keeps
# the atfork hooks unconditionally; sys_membarrier.h keeps only the
# non-CONFIG_MEMBARRIER branch; qemu-thread-common.h drops tracing and BQL
# status tracking; qemu-thread-posix.c drops the TSAN annotation and traces.
